originalLicenseNote: Engine source under GPL-3.0; embeds the network 150521a9.nn from https://github.com/KierenP/Halogen-Networks (GPL-3.0), trained by temporal-difference learning and then on the engine's self-play games with bullet.
blurb: Halogen 16 is the February 2026 release of Kieren Pearson's GPL C++ UCI chess engine, first released in 2019 and developed with OpenBench testing. It pairs singular and negative extensions, ProbCut, razoring, reverse futility, null-move with zugzwang verification, late-move, futility and SEE pruning, upcoming-repetition detection, and pawn, non-pawn, piece-move and continuation correction histories with an embedded NNUE of 8 king buckets, a 1536-wide accumulator, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper, its SSE4 net code compiled to WebAssembly SIMD through SIMDe.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper, with the thread pool's tasks run on the UCI thread and Threads fixed to 1; built by hand with the flags of the Makefile's release build, with the net laid out by the engine's own tool for its SSE4 path; that path compiled through SIMDe to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native AVX2 build's; the hash index takes the 128-bit product that the native build uses, since size_t has 32 bits; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening, MultiPV and aspiration windows.

features.label: Mate Distance Pruning
features.implementation: Alpha and beta bounded by the mate distance from the root.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification at low depth, a full razor when the position looks hopeless.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Static null-move pruning by a depth margin.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Null-move pruning with an enhanced verification search against zugzwang.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Capture search against a raised beta, guided by the hash entry.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: Rebel-style reduction of a node without a hash move.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular and multiple extensions, with multi-cut and negative extensions.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Reductions adjusted by history, cut nodes, improvement and captures.

features.label: Late-Move, Futility & SEE Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, futility and SEE pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Pawn, threat, capture, piece-move and continuation histories, plus pawn, non-pawn, piece-move and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Buckets with generations and generalized cutoffs, indexed by a 128-bit product.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded net: 8 mirrored king buckets of 768 inputs, 1536-wide accumulator, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets with float hidden layers.
